changelog: Spoken punctuation now understands symbols: say "at sign" and "dot" to dictate an email address by voice — "my email is samir at sign gmail dot com" becomes samir@gmail.com. Say "percent sign" for %, "dollar sign" for $, "apostrophe" for ' ("don apostrophe t" becomes don't) and "hash sign" or "hashtag" for #. In Bengali, say "অ্যাট চিহ্ন", "ডট", "শতাংশ চিহ্ন", "ডলার চিহ্ন", "ঊর্ধ্বকমা" and "হ্যাশ চিহ্ন". Works in the app and in the voice keyboard, only when the spoken-punctuation setting is on.
